title: Preppy's QOL
description: Preppy’s QOL Pack is a lightweight Fabric modpack focused on performance, visual polish, and subtle quality-of-life improvements. Optimized for smooth gameplay, even on low-end systems, with optional proximity voice chat support.
body:
🟢 What is Preppy’s QOL Pack?

Preppy’s QOL Pack is a Fabric-based quality-of-life modpack designed to enhance Minecraft without changing core gameplay.
The focus is on performance first, combined with clean visuals, better animations, and improved sound design — all while staying close to vanilla.

This pack is suitable for:
Low-end and mid-range systems
Players who want smooth FPS with visual polish
Vanilla-friendly survival, SMPs, and casual play

⚡ Performance Optimizations

The modpack includes a carefully chosen set of performance mods to reduce lag, improve frame times, and lower memory usage:

Sodium + Sodium Extra
Lithium
FerriteCore
Entity Culling
ImmediatelyFast
Dynamic FPS
LazyDFU

These ensure smooth gameplay even with shaders or higher render distances.

🎨 Visual Enhancements

Visual improvements are subtle and optional, focusing on clarity rather than realism:
Continuity for connected textures (glass, paths, bricks, etc.)
Fresh Animations & entity animation improvements
Improved UI elements, icons, and HUD details
Optional visual resource packs such as:
Better Lanterns
Redstone Tweaks
Visual Armor Trims
Recolourful Containers
Connected textures packs

👉 Important:
Continuity-related resource packs must be placed at the top of the resource pack list to avoid texture overrides.

🔊 Sound & Immersion

Enhanced ambient and interaction sounds
Optional sound tweaks for a cleaner audio experience
Simple Voice Chat included for proximity-based voice communication (optional)

🗂 Resource Packs & Customization

This modpack includes multiple optional resource packs.
If you experience FPS drops:
Disable heavier visual resource packs via the in-game menu
Keep performance-critical packs enabled

🌈 Shaders

Shader support via Iris
A text file is included with recommended settings for Complementary Unbound
You can import this file directly from the shader options menu

✅ Compatibility & Stability

Built for Minecraft 1.21.11
Fabric Loader based
All mods and resource packs are tested together for stability
